title: Lesson 1 Checkpoint — There is / There are
description: Show what you learned about there is / there are. You need at least 4 out of 5 correct to pass.
canDo: I can say what exists in a place using there is and there are.

questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: There is a park near my house.
There is a park near my house.
questions.answer: There is a park near my house.
